label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Elevation charts (routes and tracks) zoom: pinch to zoom the distance axis, two fingers to pan, double-tap to show the whole line. The elevation axis rescales to the visible section; distance ticks follow the window. One-finger tap and A-B drag work as before inside the zoomed view.
Hut marks on the track chart are tappable: the hut's name appears in a bubble above it, the mark turns orange and the map marks the hut's place on the track.
Track chart taller (230 dp, was 170); the expanded track sheet is 78% of the screen (was 72%).

The tapped track's highlight, distance, elevation profile and huts now use the map's own LINZ track line (zoom-14 vector data, the geometry the map draws), followed from the tapped tile into each neighbouring tile the track continues into (up to 160 tiles; loaded tiles reused). DOC's walk line is only a fallback. On Roys Peak Track DOC's line (100 points, 6.93 km) was a median 7 m and up to 83 m off the map's track and cut its zigzags; the map's line is 232 points, 7.58 km.
DOC lookups also try 'Mt'/'Mount' spellings (the map's 'Mt Iron Track' is DOC's 'Mount Iron Track').
